result.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx the diff shows `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`; showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error");`. A template literal is always a non-empty string (even with undefined parts it yields e.g. ":undefined"), so the `|| t("unable_to_add_guests")` fallback is dead code. Also the handler throws TRPCError with message codes like "booking_not_found" and "you_do_not_have_permission" which are not translation keys in the diff's locale additions, so users would see raw codes. Verifiable, real defect introduced by this diff.

adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, onError builds `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` and then calls `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")`. Because `message` is always a non-empty string (even when `err.data?.code` is undefined it becomes e.g. "undefined: ..."), the fallback `t("unable_to_add_guests")` will never be used, effectively swallowing the intended generic error message path. The translation-key concern is only partially verifiable from the diff, but the unreachable fallback is directly verifiable.
